subject: bone:distal-phalanx-of-fourth-finger-of-hand-l
claim: Forme en biseau peu évocatrice d une phalange distale de la main.

sources.name: Wikipedia — Phalanx bone (distal phalanx)
sources.excerpt: In the hand the flat wide expansions at the tips are apical tufts supporting fingertip pads and nails.

sources.name: AO Surgery Reference — Distal phalanx anatomy
sources.excerpt: The distal phalanx is divided into base, diaphysis (waist) and ungual tuberosity (tuft).

reasoning: La phalange distale de la main se termine par une touffe apicale (apical tuft / ungual tuberosity) soutenant l'onglet et la pulpe.
